Summary

Senior Product Designer with 6+ years of experience turning complex problems into clear, effective product experiences, from 0-to-1 development to evolving established platforms. Leads ambiguous product initiatives through systems thinking, research, and technical understanding, with strengths in end-to-end product design, UX strategy, information architecture, and scalable design practices. Brings experience in design leadership, mentorship, hiring, and interviewing, backed by a technical foundation in computer science, APIs, AI/ML platforms, and code-based prototyping.
